title: Afro-Peruvian heritage: Chincha, the cajón and the décima
goal: Talk about Afro-Peruvian history and music, granting points with aun cuando.
grammar: concessive clauses with aun cuando and the subjunctive

items: I can grant a point with *aun cuando* + indicative or subjunctive.
I can say what Chincha, the cajón and the décima are in Afro-Peruvian culture.
I can use the new words for the culture: *cajón*, *décima*, *esclavitud*, *tambor*.
